# Petrol Price Pakistan — Comprehensive LLM & Search Index Documentation

## Identity & Purpose
Petrol Price Pakistan (petrolpricepakistan.pk) is the digital reference standard for officially notified petroleum prices in Pakistan. We provide zero-tolerance verification for government gazettes issued by the Oil & Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) and the Ministry of Energy (Petroleum Division).

## Source Authority Hierarchy
1. Primary Official Source: Oil & Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) notified petroleum-price portal (price.ogra.org.pk).
2. Secondary Verification Source: Ministry of Energy (Petroleum Division) and Finance Division press releases.
3. Commercial Deregulated Fuels: Pakistan State Oil (PSO) published consumer price tariffs for RON 97 Octane+.

## Mathematical Precision Standard
All fuel rates are represented in internal databases as 64-bit integer paisas (1 PKR = 100 Paisas) to prevent IEEE 754 floating-point inaccuracies. Price displays round exactly to two decimal places (e.g., Rs. 386.30/Ltr).

## Complete Route Sitemap
- /: Real-time active rates for Petrol, Diesel, Hi-Octane, Kerosene, LDO, LPG, calculators, and recent revisions.
- /petrol-price-in-pakistan: Detailed Motor Spirit rates, historical revisions, and fuel tank fill calculator.
- /diesel-price-in-pakistan: High-Speed Diesel (HSD) rates and commercial freight calculations.
- /hi-octane-price-in-pakistan: Deregulated PSO Octane+ (97 RON) consumer retail rates.
- /kerosene-oil-price-in-pakistan: Superior Kerosene Oil (SKO) domestic heating rates.
- /light-diesel-oil-price-in-pakistan: Light Diesel Oil (LDO) agricultural tube-well rates.
- /lpg-price-in-pakistan: Liquefied Petroleum Gas monthly cylinder and per-kg maximum prices.
- /petrol-calculator: Multi-vehicle fuel tank fill-up cost and highway journey fuel calculators.
- /petrol-price-history: Historical audit archive of approved government circulars.
- /diesel-price-history: High-Speed Diesel historical revision ledger.
- /fuel-price-changes: Chronological log of price increases and decreases.
- /advertise: Advertising placements, audience reach, and media partnerships.
- /about: Background, mission, and operating ethics.
- /contact: User feedback, support, and editorial inquiries.
- /editorial-policy: Journalistic fact-checking guidelines.
- /disclaimer: Statutory notice on official compliance and estimation tools.
- /privacy-policy: User data privacy and cookie disclosure.

## Regulatory Schedule
- Fortnightly Petroleum Notification: The federal government notifies revisions every fortnight (effective 1st and 16th of each calendar month at 00:00 PKT).
- Monthly LPG Notification: OGRA notifies maximum consumer prices on the final working day of each calendar month for the upcoming month.
